speaker: beloved
text: Arise, my darling. Come away with me, my beautiful one.
name: The beloved (he)

speaker: beloved
text: For now the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.
name: The beloved (he)

speaker: beloved
text: The flowers have appeared in the countryside; the season of singing has come, and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land.
name: The beloved (he)

speaker: beloved
text: The fig tree ripens its figs; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come away, my darling; come away with me, my beautiful one.
name: The beloved (he)

speaker: bride
text: Have you seen the one I love?
name: The bride (she)

speaker: beloved
text: Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night.
name: The beloved (he)

speaker: beloved
text: I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit.
name: The beloved (he)
